title: 第7章 挣钱第8章 酿酒1
content_zh:
穷文富武，想练武先得赚够钱，只有当你拥有足够的钱，才能买到修炼需要的资源。
先前，追梦打算去城里买鱼肉挣钱，但经过村长的大力宣传，追梦在邹家村的形象瞬间高大起来，家喻户晓都想向追梦学习，追梦为了更好的维护自己的形象和地位，不得不把21世纪鱼肉去腥的方法分享给村民，让村民时刻记住他的好。
21世纪鱼肉去腥的方法教会给村民，就意味着追梦目前能快速赚钱的财路没了。
追梦得另行赚钱的方法，追梦想到了酒。
酒这个世界有，但度数很低，只有十几度，喝起来完全没有味道，追梦有信心蒸馏出高纯度的美酒，是一条不错的发财路。
但酒这东西制作，需要消耗粮食，这个世界粮食本身就稀少，要用来造酒，需要满足几个条件。
一是需要拿到官府的酿酒批文。
二是自己手上要有足够多的粮食。
三是需要懂得酿酒技术。
以上三个要求，追梦暂时只知道如何酿酒。
追梦打算先去一级县城卖一波鱼肉，在村民们没有反应过来前，先赚一波本金，待赚到足够的本金之后，在把酒酿出来，从而发家致富。
这天，经过几天的运筹帷幄，追梦一家已经在附近的一座1级县城里卖鱼肉。
这天阳光明媚，县城街道中间车水马龙，街道两旁巷子熙熙攘攘的人群在吆喝买卖。
“糖葫芦，一文钱一串的糖葫芦。”
“胭脂水粉，上等的胭脂水粉，走过路过不要错过。”
“刀剑，匕首，上等的刀剑匕首，便宜卖啦。”
追梦一家已经摆摊有一段时间，但就是没有生意上门，追梦也开始跟着吆喝道：“好吃的鱼肉，快来尝尝，五文钱一碗，不好吃不要钱，好吃再给钱。”
“老板，这个鱼肉真的能吃？”
一个路人问道。
这么一吆喝，还真吆喝来了一人，追梦赶紧招呼道：“五文钱一碗，先吃再给钱，不好吃不收钱，童叟无欺。”

“那好，给我来一碗尝尝！
先说好，如果不好吃，我是不会给钱的。”
路人回道。
“好嘞！”
追梦高兴的回道。
“先生，你的鱼肉，”
养母柳淼花赶紧递上了一碗道。
“嗯！
好吃！
content_en:
If you want to practice martial arts, you must first make enough money. Only when you have enough money can you buy the resources needed for practice.
Previously, Zhui Meng planned to go to the city to buy fish and meat to make money. However, after the village chief's vigorous promotion, Zhui Meng's image in Zoujia Village instantly grew. Every household wanted to learn from Zhui Meng. In order to better protect his own image and status, Zhui Meng had to share the 21st century fish meat removal method with the villagers so that the villagers would always remember his goodness.
Teaching the villagers how to remove the fishy smell from fish in the 21st century means that Chai Meng’s current way of making money quickly is gone.
Chasing dreams requires another way to make money. Chasing dreams involves drinking.
There is wine in this world, but the alcohol content is very low, only a dozen degrees, and it tastes completely tasteless. Chasing Dreams has the confidence to distill high-purity wine, which is a good way to make a fortune.
But making wine requires the consumption of food. Food is scarce in this world. To make wine, several conditions need to be met.
First, you need to obtain the official brewing approval document.
The second is to have enough food on hand.
Third, you need to understand brewing technology.
With the above three requirements, Zhuimeng only knows how to make wine for the time being.
Zhui Meng planned to go to the first-level county town to sell fish and meat, and earn some capital before the villagers could react. After earning enough capital, he would make wine and make a fortune.
On this day, after several days of strategizing, Zhuimeng's family was already selling fish and meat in a nearby first-level county.
The sun was shining brightly on this day, the streets in the county town were busy with traffic, and the alleys on both sides of the streets were bustling with people shouting about buying and selling.
"Tanghulu, a bunch of candied haws for a penny."
"Rouge gouache, the best rouge gouache, don't miss it when you pass by."
"Swords, daggers, the best swords and daggers, sold cheaply."
Zhui Meng's family has been setting up a stall for a while, but no business came to the door. Zhui Meng also started shouting: "Come and try some delicious fish and meat. It costs five cents a bowl. If it doesn't taste good, you don't need to pay. If it tastes good, I'll give you money."
"Boss, is this fish really edible?"
asked a passerby.
After shouting like this, someone actually came. Zhui Meng hurriedly greeted him: "Five cents a bowl, eat first and then pay. If it doesn't taste good, you won't be charged. Children and old men are innocent."
"Okay, give me a bowl to try!
Let me first say that if it doesn’t taste good, I won’t give you money. "
the passerby replied.
"Okay!"
Chai Meng replied happily.
"Your fish, sir,"
Adoptive mother Liu Miaohua quickly handed over a bowl and said.
"Hmm!
Delicious!
